# Names kept back: ids and names a plugin, a skill or a publisher may not use

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.creator_docs --write`. Do not edit by hand: change the code, then run it again. -->

A package writes its own name, so a name proves nothing. VOOL keeps back the names that would read as VOOL's own, as another maker's, or as a mark that someone checked the package. Pick a name of your own.

## Plugin ids

A plugin's id (`name` and `vool.id` in its setup file) may not be: the id of a pack VOOL ships, an id that is or starts with VOOL's or its maker's name (also written with digits for letters), or a name VOOL's own tools start with. The sentence shown:

> This name belongs to a plugin made by VOOL. Give your plugin a different name to install it.

Ids of packs VOOL ships: `vool-database`.

Names VOOL's own tools start with (39): `ai`, `browser`, `builtin`, `capability`, `code`, `contacts`, `demo`, `email`, `file`, `hive`, `image`, `machine`, `market`, `marketplace`, `mcp`, `media`, `memory`, `operator`, `orchestration`, `pay`, `pdf`, `plugin`, `profile`, `repo`, `respond`, `sandbox`, `sell`, `set`, `skill`, `things`, `token`, `video`, `vool-browser`, `wallet`, `watch`, `web`, `workspace`, `x`, `x402`. A few more names are kept for VOOL's own use.

| `vool-parcel-desk` | This name belongs to a plugin made by VOOL. Give your plugin a different name to install it. |

## Plugin name, maker and key labels

`vool.name`, `vool.publisher`, `interface.displayName` and each key slot's `label` are plain text. One of three sentences is shown when one is refused:

1. This plugin's name, maker or key label has hidden marks, look-alike letters, links or symbols. Write it in plain letters, numbers and spaces to install it.
2. This plugin's name, maker or key label uses VOOL's own name. Only VOOL's own plugins can carry it. Take it out to install it.
3. This plugin's name, maker or key label says it was checked or chosen, with a word like Official or Verified, or with a tick or a star. Take that out to install it.

| Name written | Answer |

## Skill names

A skill may not take the name of one of VOOL's own skills, or a name that starts with `vool-`.

| Name written | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| trip-packing | (accepted) |
| vool-helper | Names that start with "vool-" are kept for VOOL's own skills, so this skill needs another name. Pick a different one, for example "My helper", and try again. |

## Publisher names on the Skill Codex

The publisher is the part of a package id before the `/`. Kept back outright:

> vool, parad0x-labs, official and native are kept back. Publish under your own public name.

A publisher name may not read as one of these well-known names, alone or with one of the endings below (32 names): `amazon`, `anthropic`, `apple`, `aws`, `binance`, `chatgpt`, `claude`, `coinbase`, `copilot`, `deepmind`, `gemini`, `github`, `google`, `huggingface`, `kraken`, `ledger`, `mastercard`, `meta`, `metamask`, `microsoft`, `mistral`, `nvidia`, `ollama`, `openai`, `paypal`, `phantom`, `revolut`, `solana`, `stripe`, `trezor`, `visa`, `wise`.

Endings that do not make it a different name: `-ai`, `-app`, `-dev`, `-hq`, `-inc`, `-lab`, `-labs`, `-official`, `-pay`, `-plugin`, `-plugins`, `-security`, `-skill`, `-skills`, `-support`, `-team`, `-wallet`.

A publisher name may not be a role on the Skill Codex (17 names): `admin`, `administrator`, `anonymous`, `codex`, `community`, `editor`, `editors`, `everyone`, `mod`, `moderator`, `plugins`, `security`, `skills`, `staff`, `support`, `system`, `team`.

The names are read as a person reads them at a glance: digits and signs that stand in for letters count as the letter.

| Publisher written | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| `alice` | (accepted) |
| `openai` | The publisher name reads as "openai", which is someone else's name or a role on the Skill Codex. Publish under your own name. |
| `openai-official` | The publisher name reads as "openai", which is someone else's name or a role on the Skill Codex. Publish under your own name. The id says "official". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| `0penai` | The publisher name reads as "openai", which is someone else's name or a role on the Skill Codex. Publish under your own name. |
| `stripe-support` | The publisher name reads as "stripe", which is someone else's name or a role on the Skill Codex. Publish under your own name. |
| `admin` | The publisher name reads as "admin", which is someone else's name or a role on the Skill Codex. Publish under your own name. |
| `the-team` | (accepted) |
| `wiseowl` | (accepted) |

## What a title, an id or a summary on the Skill Codex may not carry

A title or an id may not carry VOOL's name, a word that says the package was checked or chosen, or a tick, star or medal. A summary may name VOOL, and may not claim a check or a choice. Those marks are given by the VOOL team on an exact version. Each answer below is the check's own.

| Field | Value written | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| title | Meeting notes | (accepted) |
| title | VOOL meeting notes | The title says "vool". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| title | Official meeting notes | The title says "Official". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| title | Featured meeting notes | The title says "featured". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| title | Meeting notes ★ | The title says "★". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| title | 0fficial meeting notes | The title says "official". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| id | alice/vool-notes | The id says "vool". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| id | alice/verified-notes | The id says "verified". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| id | alice/meeting-notes | (accepted) |
| summary | Notes for VOOL users. | (accepted) |
| summary | Tested by VOOL. | The summary says "Tested by". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
| summary | Editor's choice for notes. | The summary says "editors choice". Only the Skill Codex can mark a skill that way; take the word out. |
